authorization: User requested robustness/case comparisons of existing models and explicitly included previous7 plus MAE/Huber; no retraining
classification: Post-hoc descriptive stress audit on already-used same-source heldout222; not a new untouched final evaluation, not model selection

cohort.source: Exact previously eligible records, labels, order and exclusions preserved

extremes.empty_groups: report zero and null, never redefine bands

native_window.positions: all eligible native124 windows and earliest/lower-middle/latest fixed positions
native_window.primary_stability: person-equal mean within-record side-averaged sampleSD and range; report records with>=3 windows separately
native_window.model_response: Within-record centered native-window score-change correlation and absolute disagreement, person/record/window balanced

shorter_input.anchor: Earliest already-eligible window start per record; retain whole windows ending<=anchor+budget
shorter_input.reference: All existing eligible windows of same record
shorter_input.models: All multiwindow configurations; original single-windowCNN excluded from budget-aggregation because its fixed canonical selection is a different system, but included in common native-window tests
shorter_input.under124: unsupported native contract; measurement unavailable, do not manufacture frames
shorter_input.limitation: Prepared whole-record preprocessing is reused. This tests information/averaging dependence after preprocessing, not end-to-end shortened raw-video capture or preprocessing boundary robustness
shorter_input.clock_seconds: No conversion from frames to seconds without verified source FPS

asymmetry.metric: person-equal absolute error of predicted L-R difference; thresholds descriptive, not clinical

repeat_records.primary: person-equal |predicted record difference - true record difference| across sides/pairs
repeat_records.limitation: Different visits may reflect true gait change; no recapture repeatability/ICC/MDC claim or temporal ordering without dates

statistics.unit: person; records/sides/windows/pairs first averaged within person
statistics.scope: Descriptive intervals, no confirmatory superiority or familywise discovery claim; no selecting best short clip

figures.purpose: illustrate fixed same-record native-window response, not select favorable examples
